title: Understanding the Upanishad
content: Reading the Upanishad by someone who has experienced it can be enlightening. However, merely listening to the song does not make one the flower. True understanding requires finding the flower oneself and experiencing it firsthand. Touching the flower with one's hands is not enough; one must embody the flower to truly experience it. Listening to the Upanishad is like having a map, but the journey to becoming the flower is still ahead.
raw_text:
It's written by someone who might have touched truth (flower). Then by what he experienced that flower he wrote that song (upanishad). But lisening that song won't make you that flower. You have to find it yourself and touch it yourself.

But touching is not it. Touching involves hands. It's still distant. You might feel flowers is cold who knows the hand might be hot. Touching it is not being buddha. Being Budda is being that flower itself. Only then you can experience it.

So don't consider only by listening to that song you got the flower. It's very very far. It's just the map. Journey is still not coverd yet.
